name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label for a control, shown on hover and keyboard focus, on Base UI's Tooltip: a neutral-solid bubble at z.tooltip on any side of the trigger, with an optional keyboard shortcut.

manifest.name: tooltip
manifest.title: Tooltip
manifest.description: A short label for a control, shown on hover and keyboard focus, on Base UI's Tooltip: a neutral-solid bubble at z.tooltip on any side of the trigger, with an optional keyboard shortcut.
manifest.usage: Use Tooltip to name an icon button or add a few words to a control, never for anything the user must read to act (put that on the page) and never on a disabled control (it cannot be focused). Compose it as Tooltip > TooltipTrigger (render the IconButton; it keeps its own aria-label) + TooltipContent (side, align) with the text and an optional TooltipShortcut. Wrap a toolbar in TooltipProvider (delay) so moving between its buttons shows each tooltip at once. Keep it to one line where possible. For a richer preview on hover use HoverCard; for controls or text the user clicks to open, Popover.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when hover, focus, Escape or a press opens or closes it.

props.name: delay
props.description: TooltipTrigger and TooltipProvider: ms of hover before it opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: TooltipTrigger and TooltipProvider: ms before it closes after the pointer leaves.

props.name: side
props.description: TooltipContent: the side of the trigger; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: align
props.description: TooltipContent: how it lines up with the trigger.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: TooltipContent: the gap in px; space.inline.xs at the trigger by default.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal at the end of <body>, at z.tooltip, with the trigger's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="tooltip-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: The bubble: color.neutral.bg with color.neutral.fg text in type.caption, at most size.panel.xs wide; data-slot="tooltip-content".

parts.name: TooltipTrigger
parts.description: The control; unstyled, render an IconButton or Button through render.

parts.name: TooltipContent
parts.description: The portal, the positioner and the bubble.

parts.name: TooltipShortcut
parts.description: A <kbd> with the action's shortcut, in the code font, after the text.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: a fade over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.enter; moving within a TooltipProvider shows the next one at once (data-instant); reduced motion turns the fade off.

states.name: instant
states.description: Opened right after another tooltip of the same provider, or by focus: no transition.

accessibility: The tooltip is visual, as Base UI's: the trigger must have its own accessible name (an IconButton's aria-label says the same as the tooltip), so nothing depends on the tooltip being announced.
It opens on hover after delay and at once on keyboard focus, and closes on Escape, when the pointer leaves or when focus moves away; the trigger keeps focus throughout.
It holds no interactive content (a link or button inside cannot be reached); use Popover for that.
The bubble pairs color.neutral.fg on color.neutral.bg, which the token build checks for contrast in every mode.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the fade off.
